source.positionNote: Existing application J2000 positions are preserved; four missing HIP stars use CDS I/239 J2000 proper-motion-propagated columns and Johnson V/B-V. Seven Gaia DR3 objects use Heidelberg TAP, independently checked against AIP; six are linearly propagated to J2000, while Eta Car lacks proper motion and retains ICRS J2016 with explicit epoch. Gaia G magnitudes and neutral unknown B-V display colors are identified separately. NGC positions use the existing pinned OpenNGC facts. This is not a reconstruction of Qing-era stellar positions.
source.gaiaHipCrossmatch: Official gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour returns no records for these seven IDs; nearest existing HIP is at least 116 arcsec away. No positional merging was applied.
source.translationFallback: Native simplified Chinese and source English; missing Russian/French culture-object translations retain the source English rather than inventing a translation.
source.membershipNote: Source drawing paths are not a list of primary members: explicit parent/subsidiary connecting anchors are excluded from corrected display lines and primary membership, while source paths and their full member sets remain unchanged for audit. Canonically named unconnected primary members are retained without invented lines. Expected source-table counts, resolved membership and uncertain identifications are separate.
source.boundaryNote: No Chinese asterism polygons or exact lunar-mansion boundaries are supplied. Upstream lunar-system metadata is explicitly marked Needs confirmation and is not rendered as boundaries.
